title: ACDE: Agentic Cloud Data Engineering -- a replication, live-model evaluation, and production-hardening study of policy-gated LLM pipeline governance
description: Code, policies, evidence-campaign supervisor, adversarial corpus, analysis pipeline, committed per-run data (paper/data/) and manuscript source (paper/) for a replication and extension of arXiv:2512.23737 'Governing Cloud Data Pipelines with Agentic AI'. Includes a 560-run live-model evidence campaign (three arms: live agents, non-agent baselines, mock full), a generated adversarial corpus graded against an independent specification oracle, and closed-form sensitivity analyses.
notes: DOI is minted by the author at GitHub release time via the Zenodo-GitHub integration; this file is the pre-release metadata template (D-104, WS4).
